This is a feature of ITS. Jobs get an interrupt when a --More-- interruptis appropriate. The rules for when this is appropriate are not user-settable.
Complain to BUG-ITS I guess, but it's highly unlikely that they will do 
anything as most of the time what it does right now is the right thing.
